import json, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/dev')
import z3
import infer, genbig
from instance import parse_request

def timed(seed, style):
    x = genbig.gen(seed, style)
    inst = parse_request(json.loads(json.dumps(x)))
    eng = infer._Engine(inst)
    t0 = time.process_time()
    eng.run.__self__  # nothing
    # replicate run()'s phases
    for si in range(eng.S):
        rows, _ = eng._scope_rows(si, frozenset())
        lo = [b[0] for b in inst.snapshots[si].bounds]
        hi = [b[1] for b in inst.snapshots[si].bounds]
        lo, hi = infer._propagate(rows, lo, hi)
        extra = []
        for ci in range(eng.C):
            if lo[ci] > inst.snapshots[si].bounds[ci][0]:
                extra.append(eng.snaps[si].q[ci] >= lo[ci])
            if hi[ci] < inst.snapshots[si].bounds[ci][1]:
                extra.append(eng.snaps[si].q[ci] <= hi[ci])
        if extra:
            eng.prog.add(extra)
    t1 = time.process_time()
    if not eng.prog.sat([eng._budget(inst.max_faults)]):
        return style, seed, 'infeasible', t1 - t0, 0, 0
    lo, hi = 0, inst.max_faults
    while lo < hi:
        mid = (lo + hi) // 2
        if eng.prog.sat([eng._budget(mid)]):
            hi = mid
        else:
            lo = mid + 1
    eng.k = lo
    eng.prog.add([eng._budget(lo)])
    t2 = time.process_time()
    pats = eng._patterns()
    t3 = time.process_time()
    n = len(pats) if pats else -1
    return style, seed, 'feasible', t1 - t0, t2 - t1, t3 - t2, n

worst_k = 0
worst_p = 0
for seed in range(20, 30):
    for style in ('wide', 'narrow', 'tight'):
        r = timed(seed, style)
        if r[2] == 'infeasible':
            print('%s %d: infeasible (bounds %.2fs)' % (style, seed, r[3]))
            continue
        style, seed, _f, tb, tk, tp, np_ = r
        worst_k = max(worst_k, tk)
        worst_p = max(worst_p, tp)
        print('%s %d: bounds %.2fs k-search %.2fs patterns %.2fs (%d patterns)'
              % (style, seed, tb, tk, tp, np_))
print('worst k-search %.2fs, worst pattern-enumeration %.2fs' % (worst_k, worst_p))
PYEOF
